en: "Ah! It's Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Nice to meet you! My name's {bb}Tanishinosuke{ww}!"{KP}"I was originally a traveler going around to festivals,"{KP}"but while I was having fun picking on the mud snails here,"{KP}"before I knew it, I'd been turned into a mud snail myself!"{KP}"Right then, I heard a voice from the heavens!"{KP}"It said, 'You have tormented bugs and animals everywhere you went.'"{KP}"'So as punishment, I have turned you into a mud snail!'"{KP}"'If you wish to become human again, you must help people twice!' ...That's what it said!"{KP}"Hey, Momotaro-san! Please take me along on your journey!"{KP}"On my own I'm too scared to leave this pond!"{KP}"Come on, please?"{KN}

jp: 「ありがとう　桃太郎さん！」

en: "Pleeease! I wanna be human again!"{KP}"Come on, please? Momotaro-san!"{KN}

jp:
「あっ　桃太郎さん！
　ここらあたりで　{bb}天のはごろも{ww}を
　持った人を　見ませんでした？」
en: "Ah, Momotaro-san! Did you see anyone around here carrying a {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww}?"

jp:
桃太郎は
　首を　横に　ふった！

en: "......I see."{KP}"While I was bathing in the hot spring nearby, my {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww} was stolen!"{KP}"I chased the thief all the way here... but I lost sight of them!"{KP}"Without it, I can't return to the heavens......"{KP}"What shall I do......"

jp:
「{bb}天のはごろも{ww}が　ないと
　天に　もどれないわ……」
　{KP}
「どうしましょう……」
en: "Without my {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww}, I can't return to the heavens......"{KP}"What shall I do......"

jp:
桃太郎は
{bb}{MM}{ww}を　わたした！

「あっ！　{bb}天のはごろも{ww}……
　ありがとうございます！
　桃太郎さん！」{KP}
　
「これで　天に　もどれます！」
　
　{KP}
「お礼に
　これを　さしあげますわ！」
en: "Oh! My {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww}...... Thank you so much, Momotaro-san!"{KP}"Now I can return to the heavens!"{KP}"Please accept this as thanks!"

jp:
「おまえは　桃太郎だな！
　鬼面党に　いどむとは　生意気だど」
　{KP}
「オラの　ちからを　見せてやるど！
　さあ　勝負するど！」
en: "You're Momotaro, ain'tcha! You got some nerve takin' on the Oni Mask Gang!"{KP}"I'll show ya my strength! C'mon, let's settle this!"

jp:
鬼面党は　{bb}天のはごろも{ww}を
落としていった！
en: The Oni Mask Gang member dropped the {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww}!

jp:
「桃太郎はん！
　いろいろと　めいわくを　かけて
　ゴメンだど！」{KP}
　
「悪いが　この　{bb}天のはごろも{ww}を
　{bb}天女{ww}に　返して　ほしいど！」
en: "Momotaro-han! Sorry for causin' ya all that trouble!"{KP}"Sorry to ask, but I want ya to give this {bb}Heavenly Robe{ww} back to the {bb}celestial maiden{ww}!"

jp:
「では　頼んだど！
　桃太郎はん！」

「よく来たな！
　ここは　たにしヶ池じゃ！」
　{KP}
「タニシが　たくさん
　おるのじゃ！」
en: "Welcome! This here is Snail Pond!"{KP}"There are lots of mud snails here!"
